WFRPRB.Title: Recipe Book
WFRPRB.Empty: No recipes yet. A recipe is an item: drag it onto a character and it will appear in the book.

Abandon.Title: Abandon the work?
Abandon.Hint: Work on «{name}» stops; it has to start over.
Abandon.HintSpent: Work on «{name}» stops. Spent materials are lost: {spent}.

Craft.NoSystem: WFRP4e system not found. Rolling is impossible.
Craft.Broken: Crafting did not finish - see the console (F12)

Loss.half: Half of the materials were ruined.

Chat.FlawedLine: The work failed, but an item emerged - with the «{flaw}» flaw

Money.NoCoin: The character has no coins of the required denominations.

Hotkey.Name: Open Recipe Book
Hotkey.NoActor: Select a token or assign a primary character.

Enabled.Name: Module enabled
Enabled.Hint: Disables the recipe book for the entire table.

HighlightMoney.Name: Highlighting accounts for money
HighlightMoney.Hint: If disabled, "can craft" only checks skill and ingredients, and money is checked at crafting time.

FailLoss.Name: Loss on failure
FailLoss.Hint: What happens to materials if the total success level drops below zero.

PlayerView.Name: GM: player view
PlayerView.Hint: Show the recipe book exactly as a regular player sees it - without the World tab and recipe creation, editing or deletion.

ExtraFilters.Name: Skill and type filters
ExtraFilters.Hint: Show dropdown filters by trade skill and by crafted item type in the book.

Sheet.Label: Recipe Sheet
Sheet.CustomResult: New item: it will be created on craft completion with this name and the recipe icon
Sheet.SaveAsNewTip: Current edits become a NEW recipe; the original is restored
Sheet.SaveFailed: Field was not saved - see the console (F12)

Tip.EntryReady:
Ready to craft
All requirements met.
Tip.NoSkill:
No skill
The character lacks «{skill}» - it can be learned through advancement.
Tip.Talent: Craftsman has already lowered the target
Tip.Ingredient:
In stock {have} of {need}
~ Consumed when work begins.
Tip.Time:
Crafting time
Only non-zero units are shown: months (a month = 30 days), days, hours, minutes.
~ Does not affect rolls; guidance for the GM.
Tip.Workshop:
Workshop
The rules require a suitable workshop - ask your GM.
Tip.Progress:
Progress
SL accumulated out of required. Each endeavour between adventures allows one roll.
Tip.ToolNote: Tool: the character must have it; not consumed.
Tip.MoneyNote: ~ Minor materials without a separate item - paid in coin.

WFRPRB.NewRecipeHint:
New recipe
Creates a recipe item in the Items tab. Fill in the sheet and give it to a player by dragging it onto their character.

World.Hint:
GM registry
All recipes: world ones and copies owned by characters (versions may differ), grouped by owner. Give, edit or delete recipes from here.
World.GiveTip: The character learns a copy of this recipe
World.NoPlayers: No one to give to: no player-owned characters found.
World.MakeTip: Create the result item in the Items tab - no character, no roll

Delete.WorldTitle: Delete the recipe from the world?
Delete.WorldHint: The «{name}» recipe disappears from the registry. Copies already learned by characters stay with them.
Delete.ActorTitle: Remove the recipe from the book?
Delete.ActorHint: {actor} forgets the «{name}» recipe. It stays in the GM registry and can be given again.
Delete.WorldHintCopies: The «{name}» recipe disappears from the registry. Learned copies exist on {count} characters: {actors}.
Delete.DoneAll: «{name}» deleted from the registry and from {count} characters

Extra.OwnerTip: Filter by owner: world or character

Crit.Title: Critical success
Crit.Threshold: If accumulated SL is at least
Crit.Label: Crit
Crit.Tip:
Critical success
If the SL accumulated on completion meets the threshold, the bonus triggers.
Crit.RandomTip:
Random
ONE of the checked effects triggers, chosen at random. Players only see «special bonus» in the book.

Forge.Title: Create an item from scratch
Forge.Name: Name
Forge.FailFlawed: Botch on failure (flawed item instead of total loss)
Forge.PrognosisTip: By the rules: each flaw halves the target, then +5 per quality.
Forge.Created: Item «{name}» created in the world; the recipe has been updated
Forge.CritNote: These qualities are added to the item only on a critical success.
Forge.FailNote: What happens when the work goes poorly.

WFRPRB.EmptyRight: Pick a recipe on the left to open its spread here.

Starter.Title: Starter trade recipes
Starter.Name: Starter recipes
Starter.Hint: Adds ready-made recipes, materials and result items for trade professions to the world.
Starter.Intro: Pick professions - their recipes will be added to the world together with materials and result items. Nothing is duplicated.
Starter.Failed: Install interrupted - some items were created. See the console (F12)

FromItem.GMOnly: Only the GM can create recipes.
FromItem.Unsupported: A recipe cannot be made from this item.
FromItem.Created: Recipe for «{name}» created - fill in the skill and ingredients.
FromItem.Exists: A recipe for «{name}» already exists - opened for editing.

Welcome.Title: WFRP Recipe Book is ready
Welcome.Intro: The module adds recipe-based crafting: the system rolls, the module tracks recipes, materials and results.
Welcome.Step1: Module settings → «Create starter trade recipes»: ready recipes, materials and items.
Welcome.Step2: Your own recipe: the «Create recipe» button in an item sheet header, or «+ New recipe» in the book.
Welcome.Step3: Give a recipe to a character - they open the book with B or the button on their sheet.
Welcome.Foot: Shown once. To repeat: api.showWelcome() in the console.
